cues: And that is the answer to our cold open.
Diamond turning into graphite is downhill overall, but the hill in between is enormous, because every carbon carbon bond in the diamond's network must be broken.
At room temperature, almost no atoms ever get over it.
Your diamond is safe for billions of years.
